title: Model catalog flags: edit Python source, regenerate TS projections and snapshot
answers: How do I add a new Claude model with 1M context or fast mode toggle?
Where is per-model supports 1M context / fast mode defined?
Desktop composer missing fast mode toggle for new model
body:
Per-model capabilities (1M context, fast mode) live only on the catalog row; no hand-kept Sets remain in reasoning-effort.ts.
- Source of truth: products/tasks/backend/model_catalog.py `CatalogModel.supports_1m_context` / `supports_fast_mode` (default False, so a new model gets neither toggle until set).
- Generator: products/tasks/scripts/build_model_catalog.py `model_entry` emits `supports1MContext`/`supportsFastMode` and the interface docs.
- Generated outputs, do not hand-edit: products/tasks/frontend/modelCatalog.generated.ts and products/desktop/packages/shared/src/model-catalog.generated.ts.
- Update the snapshot products/tasks/backend/tests/__snapshots__/test_model_catalog/test_every_model_resolves_to_the_recorded_triple.json (built by `_resolved_catalog` in tests/test_model_catalog.py); it records both flags per model.
- Lookups: `supports1MContext`/`supportsFastMode` in products/desktop/packages/shared/src/model-catalog.ts, re-exported from products/desktop/packages/shared/src/index.ts.
applies: Adding or changing a model's 1M-context or fast-mode support in the tasks/desktop model catalog
